en-US.description: A local desktop tool for browsing and managing sessions, instructions, and configuration left by Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode
en-US.longDescription: Code Déjà Vu is a local desktop tool built with Tauri, SvelteKit, and Rust, for browsing and managing in one place the sessions, instructions, and configuration that Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode leave on your machine. Session parsing, search indexing, and configuration management all happen locally. The app does not upload session content to the maintainer's services; manual update checks access the GitHub Release endpoint.

zh-CN.description: 统一浏览和管理 Claude Code、Codex CLI 与 OpenCode 留在本机的会话、指令和配置资料的本地桌面工具
zh-CN.longDescription: Code Déjà Vu 是一个基于 Tauri、SvelteKit 与 Rust 的本地桌面工具，用于统一浏览和管理 Claude Code、Codex CLI 与 OpenCode 留在本机的会话、指令和配置资料。会话解析、搜索索引和配置管理均在本机完成。应用不会把会话内容上传到项目维护者的服务；手动检查更新时会访问 GitHub Release 更新地址。
zh-CN.name: Code Déjà Vu
